  async function loadFromAPI() {     try {       setApiLoading(true);       setApiError('');       // Tentative de chargement depuis l'API (dépend du cookie auth_token)       // On passe perPage=10000 pour charger toutes les données en mémoire       const [membresRes, projetsRes, donsRes, trxRes, evtRes, settingsRes, fournisseursRes, stocksArtRes, stocksCatRes, logsRes] = await Promise.all([         membresApi.list({ perPage: '10000' }).catch(() => null),         projetsApi.list({ perPage: '10000' }).catch(() => null),         donsApi.list({ perPage: '10000' }).catch(() => null),         transactionsApi.list({ perPage: '10000' }).catch(() => null),         evenementsApi.list({ perPage: '10000' }).catch(() => null),         settingsApi.get().catch(() => null),         apiCall('fournisseurs.php', { action: 'list', perPage: '10000' }).catch(() => null),         stocksApi.articles.list({ perPage: '10000' }).catch(() => null),         stocksApi.categories.list({ perPage: '10000' }).catch(() => null),         apiCall('logs.php', { action: 'list', perPage: '20' }).catch(() => null),       ]);         setData(allData);         setLoading(false);         return;       }       let ongData = initialOngData;       if (settingsRes && (settingsRes as ApiResponse<any>).success) {         ongData = (settingsRes as ApiResponse<any>).data; (logsRes as ApiResponse<any>).data : [];       const newData: AppData = {         membres: membresRes && (membresRes as ApiResponse<any>).success ? (membresRes as ApiResponse<any>).data.map(mapMembre) : await db.membres.toArray(),         projets: projetsRes && (projetsRes as ApiResponse<any>).success ? (evtRes as ApiResponse<any>).data.map(mapEvenement) : await db.evenements.toArray(),         fournisseurs: fournisseursRes && (fournisseursRes as ApiResponse<any>).success ? (fournisseursRes as ApiResponse<any>).data : [],         stocks: {           articles: stocksArtRes && (stocksArtRes as ApiResponse<any>).success ? (stocksArtRes as ApiResponse<any>).data : [],           categories: stocksCatRes && (stocksCatRes as ApiResponse<any>).success ? (stocksCatRes as ApiResponse<any>).data : [],           mouvements: [],         },         ong: ongData,         logs,       };       setData(newData);     } catch (err: unknown) {       setApiError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Une erreur inconnue est survenue');     } finally {       setApiLoading(false);       setLoading(false);     }   }   const reloadData = async () => { await loadFromAPI(); };   useEffect(() => {     initializeDatabase();     loadFromAPI();   }, []);   const addMembre = useCallback(async (m: Omit<Membre, 'id'>) => {     try {       await membresApi.create({ ...m, dateAdhesion: m.dateAdhesion });     } catch { await import('../db/services').then(mod => mod.addMembre(m)); }     await reloadData();   }, []);   const addDon = useCallback(async (d: Omit<Don, 'id'>) => {     try {       await donsApi.create({ ...d, projetId: d.projetId });     } catch { await import('../db/services').then(mod => mod.addDon(d)); }     await reloadData();   }, []);   const updateDon = useCallback(async (d: Don) => {     try {       await donsApi.update({ ...d, projetId: d.projetId });     } catch { await import('../db/services').then(mod => mod.updateDon(d)); }     await reloadData();   }, []);   const addEvenement = useCallback(async (e: Omit<Evenement, 'id'>) => {     try {       await evenementsApi.create(e);     } catch { await import('../db/services').then(mod => mod.addEvenement(e)); content: import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react'; import { Utilisateur } from '../types'; const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE || '/api'; interface AuthContextType {   isAuthenticated: boolean;   user: Utilisateur | null;   token: string | null;   login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }>;   logout: () => void;   loading: boolean; } const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | null>(null); export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {   const [user, setUser] = useState<Utilisateur | null>(null);   const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);   useEffect(() => {     verifyToken();   }, []);   async function verifyToken() {     try {       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth.php?action=verify`, {         credentials: 'include',       });       const data = await res.json();       if (data.success) {         setUser(data.user);       }     } catch {       // Non connecté     }     setLoading(false);   }   async function login(email: string, password: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {     try {       const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth.php?action=login`, {         method: 'POST',         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },         body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),         credentials: 'include',       });       const data = await res.json();       if (data.success) {         setUser(data.user);         setToken(data.token);         return { success: true };       }       return { success: false, error: data.error };     } catch {       return { success: false, error: 'Impossible de contacter le serveur' };     }   }   function logout() {     setUser(null);     setToken(null);   }   return (     <AuthContext.Provider value={{       isAuthenticated: !!user,       user,       token,       login,       logout,       loading     }}>       {children}     </AuthContext.Provider>   ); } export function useAuth() {   const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);   if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth must be used within AuthProvider');   return ctx; }

content: import { useMemo } from 'react'; import { useApp } from '../context/AppContext'; import { isBirthdayOnDate } from '../components/Membres'; import { addDays } from 'date-fns'; import type { Notification } from '../types'; export function useNotifications() {   const { data, setActiveModule } = useApp();   const notifications = useMemo<Notification[]>(() => {     const now = new Date();     const tomorrow = addDays(now, 1);     const in7Days = addDays(now, 7);     const result: Notification[] = [];     // 1. Stocks bas     const lowStock = data.stocks.articles.filter(       a => a.quantite <= a.seuil_alerte     );     if (lowStock.length > 0) {       result.push({         id: 'stock-low',         type: 'stock',         title: 'Stock faible',         message: `${lowStock.length} article${lowStock.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} sous le seuil d'alerte`,         count: lowStock.length,         icon: 'Package',         color: 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400',         module: 'stocks',       });     }     // 2. Dons en attente     const pendingDons = data.dons.filter(d => d.statut === 'en_attente');     if (pendingDons.length > 0) {       result.push({         id: 'don-pending',         type: 'don',         title: 'Dons en attente',         message: `${pendingDons.length} don${pendingDons.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} à valider`,         count: pendingDons.length,         icon: 'Heart',         color: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400',         module: 'dons',       });     }     // 3. Événements à venir (7 prochains jours)     const upcomingEvents = data.evenements.filter(e => {       const d = new Date(e.date);       return d >= now && d <= in7Days && e.statut !== 'annule' && e.statut !== 'termine';     });     if (upcomingEvents.length > 0) {       result.push({         id: 'event-upcoming',         type: 'event',         title: 'Événements à venir',         message: `${upcomingEvents.length} événement${upcomingEvents.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} dans les 7 prochains jours`,         count: upcomingEvents.length,         icon: 'Calendar',         color: 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400',         module: 'evenements',       });     }     // 4. Anniversaires (aujourd'hui + demain)     const birthdays = data.membres.filter(m => {       if (!m.anniversaire) return false;       return isBirthdayOnDate(m.anniversaire, now) || isBirthdayOnDate(m.anniversaire, tomorrow);     });     if (birthdays.length > 0) {       const names = birthdays.map(m => `${m.prenom} ${m.nom}`).join(', ');       result.push({         id: 'birthday-upcoming',         type: 'birthday',         title: 'Anniversaires',         message: birthdays.length === 1           ? `Aujourd'hui : ${names}`           : `${birthdays.length} anniversaires : ${names}`,         count: birthdays.length,         icon: 'Cake',         color: 'text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400',         module: 'membres',       });     }     return result;   }, [data.stocks.articles, data.dons, data.evenements, data.membres]);   const totalCount = useMemo(     () => notifications.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n.count, 0),     [notifications]   );   const navigate = (module: Notification['module']) => {     setActiveModule(module);   };   return { notifications, totalCount, navigate }; }

content: export function hexToRgb(hex: string): number[] {   const cleanHex = hex.startsWith('#') ? hex.slice(1) : hex;      let r, g, b;   if (cleanHex.length === 3) {     r = parseInt(cleanHex[0] + cleanHex[0], 16);     g = parseInt(cleanHex[1] + cleanHex[1], 16);     b = parseInt(cleanHex[2] + cleanHex[2], 16);   } else if (cleanHex.length === 6) {     r = parseInt(cleanHex.slice(0, 2), 16);     g = parseInt(cleanHex.slice(2, 4), 16);     b = parseInt(cleanHex.slice(4, 6), 16);   } else {     return [22, 163, 74];   }      return [r, g, b]; } export function darkenHex(hex: string, factor: number): string {   const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(hex);   const clamp = (v: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(v)));   const toHex = (v: number) => clamp(v).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');   return `#${toHex(r * (1 - factor))}${toHex(g * (1 - factor))}${toHex(b * (1 - factor))}`; }

name: create_simple_icon.js
content: const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const { PNG } = require('pngjs'); // Créer un PNG 256x256 avec un dégradé vert const png = new PNG({ width: 256, height: 256 }); for (let y = 0; y < png.height; y++) {   for (let x = 0; x < png.width; x++) {     const idx = (png.width * y + x) << 2;          // Dégradé du vert foncé au vert clair     const ratio = x / png.width;     png.data[idx] = Math.floor(22 + ratio * 100);     // R     png.data[idx + 1] = Math.floor(163 - ratio * 50); // G     png.data[idx + 2] = Math.floor(74 + ratio * 50);  // B     png.data[idx + 3] = 255; // Alpha   } } const outputPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../assets/icon.png'); png.pack().pipe(fs.createWriteStream(outputPath)).on('finish', () => {   console.log('Icone PNG créée:', outputPath); });
